name: Jezebel
source:
Jezebel is a narrative-driven visual novel set in medieval Rosegate. Play as Duvessa Devereux, a ruthless noblewoman scheming her way to power. With RPG elements and branching paths, your choices shape her fate and the future of the kingdom.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045080/Jezebel/
translation:
Jezebel是一部以中世纪罗斯盖特为背景的叙事驱动视觉小说。扮演Duvessa Devereux，一位冷酷无情的贵妇，密谋夺取权力。凭借角色扮演元素和分支路径，你的选择将决定她的命运和王国的未来。

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4045080/Jezebel/
